items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: That’s how I learned bass lines as a little kid. All the standards that Bill Kenny used to sing.

ctx.x: Oh boy. That’s great. Good story. Is there a difference in playing behind singers than playing behind —

Absolutely. Absolutely. Like I said, my first wife was a singer. So I came in contact with all that that entails. And so I got to see, naturally I knew how musician, a lot of musicians hate singers, oh my goodness, “Oh here comes one,” say ohhh. But because I was married to singers and I liked singers, and my father and my aunt they played singers, I enjoyed singers. I didn’t have a problem with them.
